HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

2. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

5. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   B. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

7. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   B. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   B. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. A — Explain symbols used on a map

4. A — Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. D — Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. C — Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Nairobi

12. D — Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
